# Repeat Grow

> Repeat Grow is a WhatsApp CRM and WhatsApp Business API platform for Indian sales and support teams. It includes a shared inbox, contacts, sales pipelines, scheduled broadcasts, no-code automations, an AI chatbot, an AI voice agent for WhatsApp calls, orders and payments (WhatsApp Pay and UPI), WhatsApp forms, browser voice calls, Shopify and Calendly integrations, and a public REST API. Setup is done for you.

Repeat Grow is built on Meta's official WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API). It is not an unofficial or jailbroken WhatsApp client, so the number stays compliant. Teams are typically live within days because Repeat Grow handles WhatsApp Business verification, number registration and data import. Prices are in Indian rupees. Every new account gets a 7-day free trial.

## Product

- Shared inbox: multiple agents on one WhatsApp Business number, with assignment, status, internal notes, saved replies, voice notes and in-browser WhatsApp voice calls. Works alongside the WhatsApp Business app (coexistence).
- AI voice agent: an AI calls leads on WhatsApp (English, Hindi or Hinglish), answers incoming calls the team misses, can be taken over live, and saves call notes (summary, to-dos, follow-up). Templates can carry a "Call Now" WhatsApp call button.
- Mobile app: Android app in early access (inbox, contacts, push notifications, calls with AI notes, broadcasts, pipeline); iOS coming soon.
- Contacts: custom fields, CSV import and export, deduplication, opt-out (STOP) handling, full conversation and deal history.
- Sales pipelines: Kanban boards with deals linked to WhatsApp conversations. Default currency is Indian rupees.
- Broadcasts: Meta-approved templates, including carousel templates. Send now or schedule, with delivery and read tracking and per-recipient variables.
- Automations and flows: visual builder with triggers, branches, waits, tags, deals and webhooks. Chatbot flows can be generated with AI.
- AI chatbot: answers from the business's own knowledge base, knows opening hours, hands over to a human on request.
- Orders and payments: send an order with a payment request in chat using WhatsApp Pay (Razorpay, PayU, BillDesk, Zaakpay) or a UPI ID. Share a catalog and turn catalog carts into orders.
- WhatsApp forms: forms that open inside WhatsApp, with answers saved to the contact.
- Integrations: Shopify (order, shipping, delivery and abandoned-cart messages), Calendly (confirmations and reminders), Connect RepeatGrow for partner apps.
- Public REST API with scoped, revocable API keys, signed outbound webhooks and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.
- Reporting: real-time dashboard, daily summary email, WhatsApp number health checks.
- Team accounts with roles: owner, admin, agent, viewer.
- Privacy: users can download their data and request account deletion (DPDP Act and GDPR aware).

## Pricing

Plans are published at https://repeatgrow.com/pricing and can be paid monthly, quarterly or yearly: Starter Rs 999 a month (Rs 2,699 a quarter, Rs 9,999 a year), Growth Rs 1,999 a month (Rs 5,399 a quarter, Rs 19,999 a year), Pro Rs 3,999 a month (Rs 10,799 a quarter, Rs 39,999 a year), and Enterprise on custom pricing. WhatsApp Business API setup is included on every plan. Meta's own per-conversation fees are billed separately by Meta. Starter covers the shared inbox, broadcasts, templates, basic automations, the AI assistant and Shopify. Growth adds pipelines, journeys, segments, catalog, orders and payments, more integrations and the AI chatbot (3,000 replies a month). Pro adds the AI voice agent for WhatsApp calls (300 minutes a month), a larger AI chatbot allowance, ad attribution, reports and the REST API and webhooks. Enterprise adds multiple numbers and custom terms. Plans also differ in contacts, team size and support level.
